title: Expert-level balance loss
goal:
Implement the expert-level balance loss of Section 3.3 (Equations 12-14). Write `expert_balance_loss(s, idx, alpha=1.0)`.

- `s` has shape `(T, N')`: the affinities $s_{i,t}$ of the routed experts, each row summing to 1.
- `idx` has shape `(T, K')`: the routed experts each token selected.
- $N'$ is `s.shape[1]` and $K'$ is `idx.shape[1]`.

The loss is $\alpha \sum_{i=1}^{N'} f_i P_i$, where $f_i = \frac{N'}{K' T} \sum_{t} \mathbb{1}(\text{token } t \text{ selects expert } i)$ and $P_i = \frac{1}{T} \sum_t s_{i,t}$. Return a float.
hints: Count the tokens per expert with `np.bincount(idx.ravel(), minlength=N')`. Each token selects an expert at most once, so this is the sum of the indicators.
$P_i$ is the column mean of `s`. It is the mean over all routed affinities, including those of experts the token didn't select.
With perfectly balanced routing, $f_i = 1$ and $P_i = 1/N'$, so the loss is exactly `alpha`.
